param_input_item.param_description: Number of water droplets to simulate. More droplets deepen the erosion.
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

description.p: Carve an existing heightfield with droplet-based hydraulic erosion. Each water droplet descends the gradient, picking up sediment on steep slopes and depositing it where it slows, producing realistic valleys, ridges and sediment fans. Feed it a tessera.ridged or tessera.diamond_square field.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.
